issues.explanation: Chapter 18 ends with Lü Bu, Zhang Liao, and Gao Shun attacking Liu Bei’s three camps, but Chapter 19 jumps to “Lü布突袭沛城” without explaining the camp battle, Liu Bei’s defeat, or why he retreats into Pei. This omits the causal bridge and makes the opening confusing; it also inaccurately suggests a direct surprise attack on the city.
issues.suggested_fix: Briefly state that Gao Shun and Lü Bu defeat Guan Yu and Zhang Fei’s camps, Liu Bei flees with a few riders to Pei, and Lü Bu pursues him into the city.
